profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Recuro Health
profile.summary:
A high-achieving and self-directed software developer with strong hands-on industrial software development experience and an intense attraction towards expanding my knowledge and improving myself as a software developer. During my employment as a Software Developer at OATI – a software solution provider company specialize in energy industry and Kipsu - a leader in messaging software solution for hospitality industry, I had a chance to work on some industrial level software products that monitor and control large-scale operations in real time. Through these experiences, I learned firsthand that each decision is crucial throughout the software development cycle especially in creating a software this scale, because one wrong decision can cause the whole project to be delayed. This same experience inspired me to want to deepen my knowledge on how to designs, creates, and maintains an optimal software solution that has a reasonable delivery time, meet the performance expectation, and satisfy the clients need. 

As a software developer, I am familiar with coding in a fast pace environment due to the nature of agile development cycle using PHP, Kotlin, MySQL, T-SQL and C#. I performed code review and software version management using Team Foundation Server in Visual Studio and IntelliJ IDEA. In addition, I improved User Experience (UX) for the products’ User Interface (UI) that I am working on with my self-taught knowledge. Besides, I am responsible for designing web service for some of the existing products using XML or JSON format under SOAP or REST protocol. I also take part in project management by coordinating and working with multiple project teams and project manager within my department. 

As a high-achieving and self-directed software developer, I am passionate about deepening my knowledge of software development process and management. That is why I also pursued the Master Degree in Software Engineer and Data Science at University of St Thomas to strive to become a better and more efficient programmer, in addition to have better understanding about AI (Artificial Intelligence) and machine learning, as this will be an essential improvement for my current profession going forward.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Explored applied AI in healthcare, built a local SOAP-note generator using Googles MedGemma model using OpenAI API specifications. 
* Design and create in-house STT (Speech-To-Text) service for transcribing doctor and patient visit consultation using Pipecat pipeline framework using Whisper model. 
* Implement the Drug to Drug and Drug to Allergy Reaction notifications for Provider when prescribing medication using FDB API. 
* Automated end-to-end reporting in Tableau Cloud, turning a manual monthly process into a reliable, hands-off pipeline. 
* Led architecture modernization efforts — audited legacy consultation flow and Function App systems, and standardized library distribution via GitHub NuGet Packages — laying groundwork for a microservices future.
* Closed security gaps found in penetration testing, hardening API authorization and bringing the platform to full compliance. 
* Built full-stack observability for external integrations with Azure App Insights + Grafana, giving engineering real-time visibility and faster incident response. 
* Architected JWT-based authentication, scaling it from a single portal to become the standard across multiple platforms. 
* Mentored fellow engineers, sharing knowledge on architecture and security practices to help grow team capability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Application Architecture
positions.description:
* Create Technical Designs for multiple integrations for not only among internal core applications, but also between internal applications and external systems.
* Review Product Requirement and tech design, identity the work each specific dev team need and ensure tech design(s) is created so that multiple teams can work in parallels with minimal roadblock.
* Implement and improve existing SSO (Single Sign-On) functionalities in Core applications for better support OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML protocol with JIT (Just In Time) user provision functionality.
* Works with DevOps team to improve core applications infrastructure and performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for leading, designing and executing SSO (Single sign-on) implementation projects between internal and external systems using both OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 protocols, to ensure seamless access to various applications while maintaining high-security standards across different industries, including hospitality and healthcare.

•	Responsible for designing end-to-end solutions that encompass application components, data flow, integration points, and security considerations; ensuring they meet business objectives while adhering to industry best practices and standards; collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and guide the development of robust, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

•	Assist Product Manager in analyzing user requirements, procedures, and problems to add additional functionalities to match the stakeholder needs, while improving existing systems.

•	Responsible for being the team lead for a small engineering team to not only ensure every engineers in the team have all the necessary resources to finish their task, but also provide support and guidance to help them improve in the technical field.

positions.title: Software Developer/Product Delivery Manager
positions.description:
•	Develop and support web applications in the areas of smart grid, energy and commodity trading, risk management, emission and renewable energy credit market, gas trading, electric transmission and congestion management.
•	Validate and design multiple interfaces, such as webAPI and ASMX, for multiple products using XML and JSON format under SOAP and REST protocol with .NET/.NET Core framework.
•	Design and implement tables, functions and store procedures in relational database structure for multiple projects using T-SQL; perform analysis on the products database structure to improve system overall performance.
•	Work with internal customers (and external customers and vendors as needed) to validate data, work flow, and business model relationships.
•	Analyze user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate or improve existing systems.
•	Consult and perform gap analysis on new business requirements and product functionality.
•	Develop, document, and revise system design procedures, test procedures, and quality standards.
•	Monitor software development life cycle of the product; Plan, direct, and coordinate the product applications releases and system integration; and manage programs and procedures for system implementation and quality assurance.
•	Manage, assign tasks, approve designs and code review for different groups of Software Developers from different existing projects.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description:
• Helped students improve their math skills and prepare for exams
• Assisted students with their homework by carefully guiding them through the problem-solving process

positions.title: Public Relations Officer
positions.description:
•	Acted as a connection between members and the organization
•	Managed time and location for events
•	Handled both internal and external communications
